facts.fact: The report says the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education began implementing a DHIS2-based EMIS in 2018 and has since added daily attendance reporting, learner records and dashboards, with the annual school census among the sources now consolidated in the Education Data Center.
The report says individual-level learner records were added to the ministry's DHIS2-based EMIS after 2018; it gives no unique learner number or national coverage.
